paper_title: MMAR A Challenging Benchmark for Deep Reasoning in Speech, Audio,   Music, and Their Mix
caption: : Task Taxonomy
model_annotation: This pie chart visually represents a task taxonomy, comparing the proportions of different analysis categories. The chart is divided into ten slices, labeled as "Professional Knowl & Reasoning," "Culture of Speaker," "Imagination," "Acoustic Quality Analysis," "Signal Layer," "Semantic Layer," "Emotion & Intention," "Speaker Analysis," "Music Theory," "Counting & Statistics," "Environmental Perception & Reasoning," "Temporal Analysis," "Correlation Analysis," and "Spatial Analysis." The slices are colored in varying shades of blue and pink. Some slices have percentage labels directly within the segment; the "Cultural Layer" slice is labeled as 14.1%, the "Semantic Layer" is labeled as 41.2%, and the "Signal Layer" is labeled as 4.3%. The "Perception Layer" represents the largest section of the pie chart, at approximately 40.4%. There is a legend provided. The segments are visually ordered with generally larger segments appearing towards the right side of the chart, and smaller segments towards the left.
